SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REG. 8948 (S)
January 3, 1941. S. B. D. 8 / 1

Close of ferry jetties by the Japanese Soldiers.

On the morning of December 31, 1940, the
Japanese military authorities in Pootung instructed all
the jetties where the ferries ply between, such as
Krochao, Tungkou, Ching Nang, Nan Moo Doo and Chow
Ka Doo to close. Only Tung Chong Road and Gee Chong
jetties are open which are in the Japanese Naval Defence
area.

It is learned that the troops under the
command of Zee Hoong Fah (徐鸿发), commander-in-
chief of the Self Defence Corps at Chuensha, Pootung,
strength about 500, who were formerly guerrilas and
during 1939, surrendered to the Japanese when they
were re-organized into Self Defence Corps, have become
lawless, often robbing and kidnapping. On December 27,
1940, they robbed the village of Er Woo Dong (二河塘),
~~the Japanese authorities despatched an interpreter and four~~
~~Pootung and at 8 p.m. on December 29, xxx Japanese soldiers~~
to the Headquarters of the Corps at Dong Mo Chao (塘墓桥)
to investigate the incident, but the soldiers of this
defence Corps killed the interpreter and two of the four
Japanese soldiers. Those soldiers immediately vacated
that region for San Tsao (三灶), Nanwei where they
are now in hiding. The Japanese military in conjunction
with some 500 soldiers belonging Ting Sih Sam, launched
attack on these renegades on December 31, 1940 in order
to clear them out and in consequence they closed all
jetties.

Original au. No 8948

1941年1月3日。 S. B. D. 8 / 1

日军关闭轮渡码头。

1940年12月31日上午，浦东的日本军方当局指示所有往返于各处的轮渡码头，如高桥（Krochao）、董家渡（Tungkou）、庆宁寺（Ching Nang）、南码头（Nan Moo Doo）和周家渡（Chow Ka Doo）予以关闭。仅位于日本海军防区内的通中路（Tung Chong Road）和济忠路（Gee Chong）码头开放。

据悉，驻浦东川沙的自卫团总指挥徐鸿发（Zee Hoong Fah）麾下部队，兵力约500人，原为游击队，于1939年投降日军并被改编为自卫团，现已无法无天，经常实施抢劫和绑架。1940年12月27日，他们抢劫了二河塘（Er Woo Dong）村，~~日本当局派遣了一名翻译和四名~~ ~~浦东士兵，并于12月29日晚8时，xxx名日本士兵~~ 前往塘墓桥（Dong Mo Chao）的该团总部调查此事，但该自卫团士兵杀害了翻译和四名日本士兵中的两名。这些士兵随即撤离该地区，前往南汇三灶（San Tsao, Nanwei），目前藏匿于此。1940年12月31日，日军联合丁锡三（Ting Sih Sam）所属约500名士兵，对这些叛变者发动攻击以将其清除，因此关闭了所有码头。

原件作者编号 8948

CONFIDENTIAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT
Date February 24, 1940.
Subject.... Footung Northern District Armed Police Corps - disarm a unit at
Kao Ka Hong, Footung.
Made by.. D.I. Tan Lien Pih ............ Forwarded by....... D. I. Crawford

Several days ago, members of the Footung
Northern District Armed Police Corps (stationed
at Kaochiao, Footung), under the command of Chin
Shing Yen (秦興炎) and a party of Japanese
soldiers proceeded to Kao Ka Hong (高家行),
Footung, and disarmed a unit of some 400 persons
under the joint command of Hsu Tze Fei (許志飛)
and Ku Kin San (顧金山). About 100 rifles,
20 pistols and two light machine guns were seized.
Hsu and Ku succeeded in escaping, however, and a
Circular Order for their arrest has been issued
by Chin Shing Yen.

Hsu and Ku were subordinates of Chin Shing
Yen, who joined the Wang Ching Wei clique at the
beginning of December, 1939. As it was proposed
in the near future to reorganize their men into
a unit of the China Peace National Salvation Army
which is being formed by the Wang Clique, Chin
requested the assistance of the Japanese authorities
and had the men disarmed. The disarmed men are
still stationed at Kao Ka Hong, Footung, pending
a selection by Chin who will retain the able-bodied
for the expansion of his unit and repatriate the
undesirable. The present strength of Chin's unit
which is known as the Footung Northern District Armed
Police Corps is over 100 all of whom are stationed
at Kaochiao, Footung.

Dan Lien-pih
D. I.
A. C. (Special Branch).

主题 ____ 浦东北区武装警察队 - 在浦东高家行解除一个单位的武装。
制作人.. 探员谭连璧（Tan Lien Pih） ____ 转呈人 ____ 探员克劳福德（Crawford）

数日前，浦东北区武装警察队（驻浦东高桥）成员，在秦兴炎（Chin Shing Yen）指挥下，伙同一队日本士兵，前往浦东高家行（Kao Ka Hong），解除了由许志飞（Hsu Tze Fei）和顾金山（Ku Kin San）共同指挥的一个约400人单位的武装。缴获步枪约100支、手枪20支及轻机枪两挺。然而，许、顾二人成功逃脱，秦兴炎已发布通缉令缉拿二人。

许、顾二人原为秦兴炎下属，于1939年12月初加入汪精卫集团。由于近期计划将该部人员整编入汪派正在组建的“中国和平救国军”的一个单位，秦请求日本当局协助并解除了该部武装。被解除武装的人员仍驻扎在浦东高家行，等待秦进行筛选，他将留用身强力壮者以扩充其部队，并遣散不良分子。秦所部现称浦东北区武装警察队，现有兵力超过100人，全部驻扎在浦东高桥。

谭连璧
探员

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ____
S. 1, Special Branch Sdd/sdhl
REPORT
Date December 11, 19 39.
Subject Reorganization of Kiaochiao Self-defence Corps into An Armed Police
Corps.
Made by D.I. Pan Lien Pih    Forwarded by D. I. Crawford

On December 1, the Kiaochiao Self-defence Corps
under Chin Shing Yen (秦兴炎), which is more than
100 strong, was reorganized and made an armed police
corps to be known as the Pootung Northern District
armed police corps. Loo Ying (盧英), the commissioner
of the Police Bureau of the Shanghai City Government
is the nominal head but the corps is actually
controlled by the Japanese Special Service Section.
Originally, this unit had a strength of some 500
members, four hundred of which were under the joint
command of Hsu Tze Fei (許志飛) and Ku Kin San
(顧金山), who were transferred to the China Peace
National Salvation Alliance Army. Chin Shing Yen
surrendered to the Japanese Authorities due to the
defection of Hsu and Ku, both of whom were formerly
his subordinates.

Pan Lien Pih
D. I.

D. C. (Special Branch).

主题：将高桥自卫团重组为武装警察队。
制作人 探员潘连璧（Pan Lien Pih）    转呈人 探员克劳福德（Crawford）

12月1日，秦兴炎（Chin Shing Yen）麾下的高桥自卫团，兵力逾100人，经重组并改编为武装警察队，命名为浦东北区武装警察队。上海市政府警察局局长卢英（Loo Ying）为名义上的首领，但该队实际上由日本特务机关控制。该部队原有兵力约500人，其中四百人由许志飞（Hsu Tze Fei）和顾金山（Ku Kin San）共同指挥，已被调往中国和平救国同盟军。由于许、顾二人（原为其下属）叛逃，秦兴炎向日本当局投降。

潘连璧

Special Branch.

"A"
Misc. 11/40.        Central
                    Jan. 3rd,       40.
1.

Member of the Nanwei Anti-Communist
Peace Preservation Corps dies of
bullet wounds in the Lester Hospital.

Sir,

The under-described person was brought from
Shantung Road near Hankow Road by C.P.C. 2993 who
had found him suffering from a bullet wound and being
conveyed to Hospital in a public ricsha by one named
Ching Kwei Yu (金桂余) at 12.30p.m. Jan. 3.
Chiang Chu Hsing (蔣祝興), 21, Pootung,
s/Volunteer, Tung Hsing Woo Kah
(中心同德行), Nanwei (南匯), Pootung.

The wounded man was immediately removed to the
Lester Chinese Hospital, where he was pronounced dead on
arrival.

Death was apparently due to bullet wounds, an
examination of the body revealed that the deceased had
been shot in the lower region of the back, and that
the bullet had penetrated the intestines emerging from the
centre of the abdomen.

The deceased is a member of the Nanwei Section of
the Anti-Communist Peace Preservation Corps (南匯區防共
保衛隊), and according to a letter chopped by officials
of this organisation, the deceased had accidentally shot
himself at 3p.m. Jan. 2, 1940.

No medical service being available at Nanwei the
deceased was accordingly brought to Shanghai from that

                    1月3日，       40年。
1.

南汇反共保卫队成员因枪伤死于莱斯医院。

先生，

下述人员由巡捕 2993 号从汉口路附近的山东路带来，发现其身受枪伤，并于1月3日下午12时30分由一名叫金桂余（Ching Kwei Yu）的人用公共人力车送往医院。
蒋祝兴（Chiang Chu Hsing），21岁，浦东人，
隶属南汇（Pootung）中心同德行（Volunteer, Tung Hsing Woo Kah）义勇队。

伤者立即被送往莱斯华人医院，抵达时被宣布死亡。

死因显然是枪伤，尸体检查显示死者背部下方中弹，子弹穿透肠道并从腹部中心穿出。

死者系南汇区防共保卫队（Nanwei Section of the Anti-Communist Peace Preservation Corps）成员，根据该组织官员盖章的一封信件称，死者于1940年1月2日下午3时意外走火自伤。

由于南汇没有医疗服务，死者遂由此

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 1, Special B
REPORT
Date Decemb

Subject: Nanhwei Anti-communist Self Defence Corps - Commanders De
by Japanese Special Service Section at Chowpu.
Made by D. I. Lan Lien Pih Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

On December 8, at 9 a.m., Chang Liao Keng
(張妙根) and Liu Te Ching (劉鐵城), company
commander and vice commander of Nanhwei Anti-communist
Self Defence Corps, were detained at Chowpu by the
Japanese Special Service Section together with twenty-
seven of their body-guards, who were disarmed. It
is reported that their detention is the result of a
recent quarrel between their units over the collection
of taxes which came to the notice of the Japanese
Authorities. According to reliable sources, it is
expected that Chang and Liu will be released after
having been reprimanded. It is learned that Chang
Liao Keng was formerly a loafer in Nanhwei, while Liu
Te Ching was formerly a company commander in the 57th
division of the Chinese National Army, and remained
in Nanhwei after the withdrawal of the Chinese forces
from Shanghai towards the end of 1937. Later, Liu
surrendered to the Japanese Authorities through
negotiations conducted by Chang Miao Keng, and because
of this, Chang was appointed commander of the Corps
after reorganization, although Liu is the more
influential among the men under their command.

Pan Lien-pih
D. I.

D. C.(Special Branch).

主题：南汇反共自卫队指挥官在周浦被日本特务机关拘留。
制作人 探员兰连璧（Lan Lien Pih） 转呈人 探员克劳福德（Crawford）。

12月8日上午9时，南汇反共自卫队连长张妙根（Chang Liao Keng）和副连长刘铁城（Liu Te Ching），连同其27名保镖，在周浦被日本特务机关拘留并解除武装。据报道，他们的拘留是由于其部队之间近期因征税发生争吵，引起了日本当局的注意。据可靠消息来源，预计张、刘二人在受到训斥后将被释放。据悉，张妙根原是南汇的一个无业游民，而刘铁城原是中国国民革命军第57师的连长，在1937年底中国军队从上海撤退后留在南汇。后来，刘通过张妙根的斡旋向日本当局投降，因此，尽管刘在其部下中更有影响力，张在重组后被任命为该队队长。

潘连璧
探员

副总监（特科）。

Subject. Further reorganization of the "Shanghai City Government" police unit
into the "Nanwei Anti-Communist Peace Preservation Corps".
Made by D.I. Pan Lien-pih, Forwarded by D.I. Crawford.

Vide Special
Branch Report
dated 1/11/39

E.

The former "Nanwei Anti-Communist Self Defence
Corps" possessing a strength of 700 men under the
command of Chang Miao Keng (張妙根) was reorganized
on October 23, 1939 and made the "Shanghai City
Government" police unit to operate at Chowpu. A
condition attached to this reorganization was that
Mayor Fu Siao An pay the new unit $30,000.00 per
month in salaries.

No payment has ever been made by the "Shanghai
City Government" and Chang Miao-keng has decided to
reorganize the unit again and make it the "Nanwei Anti-
Communist Peace Preservation Corps" as from December
2, 1939, and has appointed Liu Ti Chen (刘銳城) as
his deputy.

When the reorganization took place of the
"Shanghai City Government" police unit, Chang Miao-
keng ceased his collection of all taxes in that area
and followed this procedure until the end of November
when the unit failed to receive the money promised.
Chang Miao-keng then approached the Japanese Military
Authorities at Chowpu and requested instructions, when
he was informed that he should reorganize the unit
into the so-called "Nanwei Anti-Communist Peace
Preservation Corps" which would be under the direction
of the Japanese garrison. The Japanese authorities,
however, refused to be responsible for the monthly
pay of the unit and authorized Chang to raise money
in the districts under his jurisdiction.

D.C. (Special Branch).

Pan Lien-pih
D. I.

日期：1939年12月7日。

主题：进一步将“上海市政府”警察部队重组为“南汇反共保卫队”。
制作人 探员潘连璧（Pan Lien-pih），转呈人 探员克劳福德（Crawford）。

参见特科
1939年11月1日
的报告

E.

原由张妙根（Chang Miao Keng）指挥、兵力700人的“南汇反共自卫队”，于1939年10月23日重组，改为在周浦活动的“上海市政府”警察部队。此次重组附带的一个条件是，市长傅筱庵每月向新部队支付薪水30,000.00美元。

“上海市政府”从未支付过款项，张妙根决定再次重组该部队，自1939年12月2日起改为“南汇反共保卫队”，并任命刘锐城（Liu Ti Chen）为其副手。

当“上海市政府”警察部队进行重组时，张妙根停止了在该地区的所有税收征收，并一直遵循此做法直到11月底，当时该部队未能收到承诺的款项。随后，张妙根前往周浦的日本军事当局处请示，被告知应将部队重组为所谓的“南汇反共保卫队”，该队将由日本驻军指挥。然而，日本当局拒绝负责该部队的月薪，并授权张在其管辖区域内筹款。

副总监（特科）。

潘连璧
探员

Subject (in full)....Self Defence Corps at Pei Tsai (北蔡) and Huang Wei (横沔)
Villages, Nan Hwei Hsien, Footung, recruits members in Shanghai.
Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken ............Forwarded by C Claxton

D.G 'A'
Central

Agents of the Japanese sponsored Self Defence
Corps of Footung have during the past week recruited
male Chinese of the beggar type from different parts
of the Settlement and French Concession for service
in this Corps. Those people will be stationed in the
villages of Huang Wei and Nan Hwei, Footung and leave
No. 13 Pontoon, the Bund between 6.30 a.m. and 7 a.m.
daily by steam launch. Each recruit is paid $3.00
before leaving and as far as could be seen no coercion
was used.

It is reported that the recruiting will last
for some days.

Subject (in full) Steel Helmet for a Self Defence Group in the Western District.

Made by D.S.I. Kao Yen Ken Forwarded by G. Casola

The Hsu Fah Shing (徐發興) Blacksmiths' Works,
241 North Fokien Road, and the Ma Shen Shing (英順興)
Blacksmiths' Works, 355 Boone Road, are undertaking
the preparation of 450 steel helmets, which will be
painted grey and bear the emblem of a white star on

for each helmet ordered is $7.50. Enquiries made at

REPORT
Date November 3, 1939.

Subject. Chow Ka Chiao Village Self Defence Corps - Chief murdered.

Made by D.S.I. Liao Chung Chien Forwarded by C [Signature]

With reference to the attached translation of
an extract from the Shun Pao, dated 31/10/39, on
the murder of Tsang Miao Keng (張妙根), alias Tsang
Chi (張琪), enquiries ascertain that Tsang, the
deceased, was an ex-guerilla commander in Pon Sing
Kying Village but surrendered to the Japanese military
about two months ago. Subsequently he was appointed
Chief of the Chow Ka Chiao Village Self Defence Corps,
which has an office on the premises of the now defunct
Chow Ka Chiao Merchants Volunteer Corps, and became
a prominent figure in the village in which his cousin
Chang Shiao Di (張小帝) is a well-to-do resident.

It is reported that a month ago, a number of
his former colleagues who are still working in guerilla
corps in the suburbs of Chow Ka Chiao Village, approach-
ed Tsang for monetary aid. The latter, however,
instead of donating any contributions to the callers,
caused three of them to be arrested and later executed
by the Japanese military. It is said that the
guerillas, to avenge the death of their three deceased
comrades, shot and killed Tsang Miao Keng in front
of the premises of the Chow Ka Chiao Village Self
Defence Corps on October 30.

Tsang Miao Keng, the subject of this report,
should not be confused with Chang Miao Keng (張妙根),

事由：周家桥村自卫团——团长被杀。

制作：警探长廖仲坚（Liao Chung Chien） 转呈：C [签名]

关于附译的1939年10月31日《申报》摘录中提及的张妙根（Tsang Miao Keng），又名张琪（Tsang Chi）被杀一案，经查询查明，死者张氏原为潘星泾村（Pon Sing Kying Village）的游击队指挥官，但于约两个月前向日军投降。随后，他被任命为周家桥村自卫团团长，该团办公地点设在现已解散的周家桥商团义勇队旧址内，他因此成为该村的风云人物；其堂兄弟张小帝（Chang Shiao Di）是该村的一位富裕居民。

据报，一个月前，数名仍在周家桥村郊区游击队中服役的前同事向张氏寻求金钱援助。然而，后者不仅未向来访者提供任何捐款，反而导致其中三人被捕，并随后被日军处决。据说，游击队为给这三名死去的同伴报仇，于10月30日在周家桥村自卫团办公处门前枪杀了张妙根。

本报告所涉之张妙根，不应与张妙根（Chang Miao Keng）（張妙根）混淆，

Shun Pao, Sin Wan Pao :- 31.10.39 (PM)
POLICE OFFICIAL SHOT DEAD IN POOTUNG Chow Ka Kiao
Chang Miao-keng (張妙根) alias Chang Chi
(張琪), age 32, native of Lunghwa, is the cousin of
Chang Ziao-dee (張小弟), the proprietor of a bean curd
shop who is chief of the Maintenance Association at
Chow Ka Kiao (周家橋), Western District. Recently
he was appointed chief of the Police Corps at Chow Ka
Kiao.
Yesterday, while Chang was on his way home
from a bath house, he was shot at by two men when near the
Police Corps quarters, killing him on the spot. The
attackers made good their escape.
page_data.zh:
《申报》，《新闻报》：1939年10月31日（下午版）
浦东周家桥一警官被枪杀
张妙根（Chang Miao-keng）（張妙根），又名张琪（Chang Chi）（張琪），32岁，龙华籍，系西区周家桥（Chow Ka Kiao）一家豆腐店店主、周家桥维持会会长张小弟（Chang Ziao-dee）（張小弟）的堂兄弟。他最近被任命为周家桥警察队队长。
昨日，张氏从浴室回家途中，行至警察队营房附近时，遭两名男子开枪射击，当场毙命。袭击者成功逃脱。
